name: Cinnamon Sugar Pillow Cookies
desc: Small egg-free cookies with a sweet cream cheese center, rolled in cinnamon sugar.

source.title: Cinnamon Sugar Pillow Cookies
source.evidence: Same name; matches the site's 1 1/2 cups flour, 1/2 cup sugar, 6 tbsp oil and 1 1/2 tbsp milk. The page says 'equal parts cinnamon and sugar' for the coating; 2 tbsp each is a judgment amount.

ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 tbsp whole milk, plus more if the dough is dry
ingredients.note: plus more if the dough is dry

ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup (2 oz) full-fat block cream cheese, room temperature

steps: Preheat the oven to 325°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Filling: beat the cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth. Set aside.
In a mixing bowl, stir together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt and sugar.
Stir in the oil, milk and vanilla to form a soft dough. If it is too dry to hold together, add more milk 1 tsp at a time.

Roll the dough into 16 balls (about 1 1/2 tbsp each). Split each ball in half and flatten both halves. Put about 1/2 tsp filling on one half, cover with the other, pinch the edges closed, and roll smooth.
Coating: mix the sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl. Roll each ball in it and place 2 inches apart on the baking sheet.
Bake on the center rack 11 minutes. They will look underdone; let them cool on the sheet 10 minutes, where they firm up.

references.title: Cinnamon Sugar Pillow Cookies
references.usedFor: 16 cookie yield, parchment and center rack, extra milk if dry, underdone-then-firms cue
